selection.rationale: Strategy-local MACE optimization outcomes demonstrate that unstrained, high-symmetry (SG 75-230) AFLOW prototype and AFLOW charge-compensated oxygen-vacancy generators achieve consistently high convergence, low RMS atomic displacements, and distinct final geometry hashes across all size tiers, whereas PyXtal and strained/low-symmetry generators suffer frequent non-convergence and large structural reconstructions. Accordingly, we concentrate the 64-structure budget on proven unstrained high-symmetry AFLOW prototype actions across tiers 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32—specifically NbO2 (4423a23efccd1e8f, 416747e6292c69c0, b4a392175d4f86aa, 82ecef7f5b8449cc), TaO2 (cce0798ec12a7fe0, 3a5c87f7accb7740, 7b6cce5359a9991f, 1e45360f266988a6, f2c445620e608d97), and mixed NbTaO4 (8814fba18db6c4d7, 58dcbcceff0acdad, 63332547fc97ff60, cf5b1228bef3acec)—while maintaining productive AFLOW oxygen-vacancy sampling (204a3115d99897e6, 4042184642def540, 12ee11e19f22fb89) and targeted unstrained high-symmetry pentoxide exploration (812c01e5c5651ed4, 2b359ca884ba50f7) within remaining shared group capacities.
